GAME.is_space_loaded number/string cases route0x00aa7900. Its meaning and results are outside this module.
QUEST.get_stage/set_stage likewise admit the typed0x390 fast path; number/string routes and key0 fallback are not modeled.
Required-argument setup0x010a9210 precedes wrapper checks; missing-argument semantics are not inferred from the later fallback.

properties: Separate exact32-bit words; never a combined64-bit Lua number
Opaque tokens remain interned and immutable in shared carrier
Foreign realm tokens, ordinary numbers/strings, wrong domains and malformed words are rejected
Unknown canonical type11 domains may be transported but have no kind and cannot pass typed quest/space accessors
Creating a typed key does not prove resource existence or validity

limits: Marshaling support only, not native engine implementation or Lua query results
No numeric/string coercion or fallback behavior imitation
No native callback execution performed by these tests
Only quest and space domain interpretation established; do not infer other domains by pattern
